_comment: Hermes Agent (web) yang connect ke 9Router terpisah. Import di Admin > Nests > Import Egg.
name: Hermes Agent (9Router)
author: admin@example.com
description: Hermes Agent dengan web dashboard + chat. Model AI diambil dari 9Router kamu yang berjalan terpisah (Claude, GPT, Gemini, 60+ provider).
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; node index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Installer egg Hermes Agent (web): hanya clone repo GitHub kamu.
# Python, dependency, dan build dashboard terjadi otomatis saat server START pertama.
apt-get update -y >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
apt-get install -y git ca-certificates >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
  echo "GIT_ADDRESS kosong. Upload isi repo lewat File Manager, lalu start server."
  exit 0
fi

GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS%/}"
[[ "${GIT_ADDRESS}" != *.git ]] && GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"
if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
  GIT_URL="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e "${GIT_ADDRESS}" | cut -d/ -f3-)"
else
  GIT_URL="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
fi

if [ -d .git ]; then
  echo "Repo sudah ada, git pull..."
  git pull || true
elif [ -n "$(ls -A /mnt/server 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  echo "Folder server tidak kosong dan bukan repo git; clone dilewati."
else
  git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH:-main}" "${GIT_URL}" . || { echo "Clone gagal. Cek GIT_ADDRESS/BRANCH/token."; exit 1; }
fi
chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Selesai. Klik Start: instalasi pertama 5-10 menit, pantau di console."

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 1 = git pull setiap start (update otomatis dari GitHub).

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal access token GitHub (hanya untuk repo private).

variables.name: URL 9Router
variables.description: Alamat 9Router kamu, contoh http://123.45.67.89:20128 atau https://9router.domainkamu.com

variables.name: Model
variables.description: ID model / nama combo di 9Router, contoh kr/claude-sonnet-4.5

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password login dashboard Hermes. Kosong = dibuat acak (lihat console).

variables.name: Extras Hermes
variables.description: Extra Python Hermes, pisahkan koma. Tambah telegram/discord untuk bot.
